correctness.rationale: The formal positivity-based ordinal reduction proves every EF1 terminal bundle pattern is (2,1,1) and tests the exact two singleton-vs-double inequalities. The alternating adversary/allocator finite-game recurrence is necessary and sufficient for an online winning strategy, and tie-refinement extends it to all positive numerical multisets. Two separate runnable C++17/Python implementations agree on unrestricted and three restricted initial results; Python additionally verifies complete 27- and 18-leaf adaptive adversary certificates. This establishes all quantifiers within precisely n=3,m=4, without extrapolation to larger horizons.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial positive-values instance beyond one good per agent is m=n+1. At that natural boundary, exact frequency knowledge yields exact 3-agent EF1 despite only a half-EF1 all-horizon guarantee; the explicit failures of two simple early-allocation policies show that genuinely adaptive allocation structure is required. The result is a complete infinite-cardinality valuation-domain statement, not an arbitrary numerical example or previously tabulated special case.
